name: A Few Ways In
thesis: A midnight-purple exhibition folio led by a large typographic index. Four editorial plates introduce making, code, teaching, and community before unfolding into a complete personal story.
interaction: Choose a facet or use arrow keys, Home, and End while the index is focused. The image, title, description, and chapter link turn together in a brief page-reveal transition; the full story remains readable below.
why: Keeps the purple warmth, expressive typography, actual project imagery, and personal letter of the favorites, while giving One Stone teaching, VEX shop leadership, Stardance software contributions, and Outpost support their own generous space.
